headwords: cầm đèn chạy trước ô tô

flags.why: The example explains the expression instead of using it to refer to a penis.
flags.fix: Anh ta bị đá trúng cần tăng dân số. = He was kicked in his "population-boosting tool".

flags.why: This is mainly Southern vocabulary, as documented in [Từ điển từ ngữ Nam Bộ](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html), but lacks a regional tag.
